title: goniophlebium argutum
intro: Goniophlebium argutum, commonly known as the Elkhorn Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its unique, branching rhizome and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The Elkhorn Fern is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
